one_line: Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO valued around $1.5 to $1.7 trillion while wider AI stock sell-offs and trade regulations unfolded.

themes.title: Anthropic raises $81.3B in historic IPO
themes.text: Anthropic went public with a record-shattering IPO raising $81.3 billion and valuing the company at over $1.5 trillion, though shares dipped in after-hours trading amid a broader AI stock sell-off and scrutiny of circular financing models.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B

themes.title: U.S. approves chip exports and weighs AI rules
themes.text: The U.S. Commerce Department approved sales of over 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, while California's Attorney General subpoenaed Nvidia regarding former CEO Jensen Huang and chip access, and the Trump administration weighed new disclosure rules for Chinese AI models.

stories.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies

themes.title: AI models advance in physics and research
themes.text: Anthropic's Claude solved two long-standing problems in black hole physics, researchers highlighted 35 human labs deploying collaborative science agents that published 936 papers, and Google DeepMind outlined four pathways from AGI to ASI.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude model solves two open problems in black hole physics
